name: After § 34
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 34a. Stresses that freedom of expression, media freedom and political pluralism are indispensable foundations of democracy and must not be weakened on the pretext of countering the spread of disinformation; warns that public authorities, EU institutions, regulatory bodies, platforms or publicly supported fact-checking structures must not become arbiters of political truth or acquire, directly or indirectly, the power to determine which lawful opinions may participate in democratic debate; insists that lawful political speech, journalistic activity and legitimate dissent must not be censored, suppressed, de-amplified, demonetised or otherwise disadvantaged on the basis of political, ideological or contested assessments of what constitutes disinformation; rejects any mechanism that could result in viewpoint discrimination, direct or indirect censorship, political pressure on media or platforms, or the creation of privileged categories of officially approved information sources; underlines that the protection of democracy can only be credible if it begins with the protection of citizens’ freedom to hear, express and debate competing views, including views that are controversial, unpopular or critical of the EU institutions themselves;
